Standard: The air vehicle ground handling characteristics are no worse than Level 2 handling qualities during takeoff, landing, and taxi maneuvers. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the ground handling qualities during takeoff, landing, and ground maneuvers as specified in ADS-33E-PRF, Rotor Start/Stop, Parked Position Requirement, and Wheeled Rotorcraft Ground Requirements paragraphs for each air vehicle configuration and internal loading. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the ground handling qualities during takeoff, landing, and ground maneuvers as specified in ADS-33E-PRF, Rotor Start/Stop, Parked Position Requirement, and Wheeled Rotorcraft Ground Requirements paragraphs for each air vehicle configuration and internal loading. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the ground handling qualities during takeoff, landing, and ground maneuvers as specified in ADS-33E-PRF, Rotor Start/Stop, Parked Position Requirement, and Wheeled Rotorcraft Ground Requirements paragraphs for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and internal loading.
